blocks.t: FREE 4-way game linking on Cruis'n Exotica is now available!

The software to update from version 1.3 or later to version 2.0 is a 2 Eprom update (version 2.0) and goes in position U10 & U11. Please contact Patty Howard (Sales Manager for the Midway Parts & Service Group) at telephone number 847-785-3031 to order updates (A-23891) if you need them. (Each order contains a complete set of Eproms to update 4 games)
Note: Version 2.0 is not compatible with any other version of Cruis'n Exotica software. When linking (even 2 games) all games must have the same version software.

Note: Games that have 1.0 version software will require 4 Eproms to update to the 2.0 version. Although there are few games with this level software, you will need to contact Midway Parts and Service to obtain U12 & 13 in addition to U10 & 11.
